scope: Primary-source practical route review; family analogues are not exact-candidate feasibility passes

sources.evidence: Post-functionalization of chloromethylated polystyrene with potassium phthalimide in DMF at 70 C
sources.limit: Solution-polymer precedent; crosslinked-bead access, MeCN behavior and exact diimide precursor routes unestablished

sources.evidence: Viologen-functionalized Merrifield resin prepared from a monoalkyl bipyridinium precursor in refluxing MeCN
sources.limit: Related viologen substitution; exact candidate, ion pairing and counterion model remain candidate-specific
sources.reported_result: Covalent bead functionalization; approximate 75% conversion assumption consistent with parts of elemental analysis, not exact yield

sources.experimental_source_location: coauthor Choi thesis p.51; institutional primary-source search extract
sources.evidence: AQ-2-carboxylic acid attached to chloromethylated polystyrene through a benzyl ester
sources.reported_result: 80% isolated polymer mass yield; not site conversion
sources.limit: New linker graph; not our phenolic AQ models; soluble precursor polymer differs from crosslinked beads

sources.evidence: Vanillin attached to Merrifield resin before aldehyde reduction
sources.access: publisher abstract verified; detailed graft conditions not extracted from publisher full text
sources.limit: Phenolic class analogue only; no exact BQ/AQ precursor feasibility or MeCN conditions established

sources.evidence: HMDS bases can convert chloromethyl polystyrene into aminomethyl resin in attempted alkoxide chemistry
sources.limit: Evidence of competing support chemistry; not a quantified side-reaction model for every base or motif

note: No exact route is automatically certified by a family analogue. Reviewed candidate evidence is added separately. Interaction-method controls may be investigated without being synthesis-shortlist admissions.
